text: Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP) recounts, in the commenter's own text, a concrete personal anecdote (their own specific experience, or that of someone they personally know) illustrating real-world consequences of the OP's claim (consequences if the claim holds or is acted on). The claim is identified from title and argument (context only). Returns 0 if no comment does: only abstract/theoretical arguments, general facts, hypotheticals/invented scenarios, or others' quoted experiences not adopted by the commenter. Quoted OP text or quoted opponents' positions don't count. Ignore view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is neither an announcement nor an anecdote. Don't infer timing or order. Empty comment list -> 0; missing/malformed OC_comments, or missing title and argument so the claim can't be identified -> null.
